thread:
Alex: Customer asked if we can do a shared KMS proxy for BYOK across multiple tenants to save infra costs.

Sara: We can but must treat proxy as tenant-aware. Audit events must carry tenant_id, key_id, and attestation_digest. No cross-tenant artifacts in same bucket.

Mike: Pooled proxy increases blast radius. Threats: enumeration, lateral access if auth isn't strict. Recommend mTLS, per-tenant mTLS certs to HSMs and strict admin API deny-lists.

Alex: For RBAC changes what minimal privileges do we need for tenant services? Want least privilege.

Jess: Suggest policy snippet:

```
- resource: /kms/proxy/tenants/{tenant}/keys/{key}
  actions: [encrypt, decrypt, get-metadata]
  principals: [svc:tenant-{tenant}]
```

List-keys/list-tenants should be platform-admin only.

Sara: Audit enrichment required: request_cert_subject, hsm_attestation_digest, proxy_image_digest, route_policy_version. Store per-tenant immutable streams (separate S3 prefixes + write-once ledger).

Mike: Incident response: need ability to isolate a tenant instantly. Console + API 'isolate-tenant' that does: 1) block proxy routes, 2) revoke tenant envelope key, 3) snapshot and freeze audit stream, 4) notify sec and legal.

Jess: I'll own the runbook and test playbook. Oncall-bot: Tenant isolation runbook link updated: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tenant-isolate

Alex: Compliance: do we require customer HSM attestation certs? They said FIPS & manufacturer attestation.

Sara: Yes if they claim custody. We accept signed device certs + vendor attestation; we validate chain and store digest in attestation ledger. Also require proof-of-possession flows for key import ops.

Mike: Security note: Never log raw key material or unredacted secrets. Implement strict log-redaction in proxy and CI smoke tests to verify.

Jess: Action items: Alex confirm pooled vs per-tenant by EOD. Sara draft RBAC + audit schema. Mike run threat model and mitigation list. Jess author and test tenant isolation runbook.

Alex: Heads-up: pooled proxy will need extra legal addendum. Looping in Legal and PCI if payments are involved. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Sara: I'll publish gating checklist tomorrow: attestation, per-tenant audit streams, envelope-key separation, operator JIT entitlements, SRR for revocation.

Mike: Adding automated smoke checks for key access paths to CI for proxy image.

Jess: tagging @sre @legal @pci for visibility.

Alex: I'll update post-customer call and close the loop.
